story.sq03.title: Names in the Empty Column
story.sq03.summary: Replace the blank handover column with named, limited duties and explicit consent. A verified responsibility charter is one requirement for Returning Rain.
story.sq03.s1.objective: Read the original thirty-day handover field and the prepared duty cards.
story.sq03.s1.journal: Shen’s thirty days became thirteen years because no successor or review was named. This charter must assign real physical work, a term, a relief rule, and a right to withdraw. No duty belongs to Shen after release.
story.sq03.s1.lan: There is room here for a title and none for a person. I can take lamp and spillway inspection for one season. Put my own name beside it.
story.sq03.s1.apprentice: I will bridge the start-up, not volunteer for an unnamed lifetime. Who checks the gauge, and who covers a missed shift?
story.sq03.s1.note: Archive handover, thirteen years earlier: “Temporary governor: Shen Heng. Maximum term: thirty days. Replacement custodian: [blank]. Reviewing witnesses: [blank].” Present duty offers: Lan—spillway; Qiao—gauge and stonework; He—allocation board; Su—weekly cross-check. Each offer is limited to one season and awaits the selected charter’s signed acceptance.
story.sq03.s2.objective: Choose an inspection rota and dispatch the charter for each named person’s consent.
story.sq03.s2.journal: Daily physical inspections remain the same. Rota A reviews them weekly at the sanctuary board. Rota B carries duplicate logs to the lower-valley board weekly. Neither makes one keeper permanent; withdrawal requires a safe pause or a consenting replacement.
story.sq03.s2.lan: A meeting here is easier for me. Copies below make it easier for them to challenge a missed inspection. I will accept either, if everyone else signs freely.
story.sq03.s2.clue: Charter: one-season terms; daily lamp, gate, and gauge checks; weekly Su/He cross-check; Qiao’s relief team covers one missed shift; if no relief agrees, stop work releases safely. Apprentice provides a start-up bridge of at most three days, then scheduled seasonal checks. Shen is exempt. Courier consent takes twelve in-game hours.
story.sq03.s2.choice_a: Send the sanctuary review rota with public minutes.
story.sq03.s2.choice_b: Send the duplicate-log rota with lower-valley review.
story.sq03.s2.reply_a: The public meeting date and the safe-pause rule are included. No one inherits a missing person’s duty by silence.
story.sq03.s2.reply_b: The duplicate logs will show the same missed shifts as the original. Copying a record will not count as doing the inspection.
story.sq03.s3.objective: Read all four consents and their limits, then test the safe-pause handle before signing.
story.sq03.s3.journal: Returning Rain requirement: handover accepted. Complete only when Lan, Qiao, He, and Su consent to the selected rota, the safe pause is tested, and I accept my limited term. A blank, coerced, or endless duty cannot qualify.
story.sq03.s3.lan: The courier took twelve hours. Qiao signed the relief rule; He and Su signed each other’s check. My signature is here. Read your own three-day limit out loud before signing.
story.sq03.s3.apprentice: Three days for start-up. Seasonal checks afterward. If the network cannot carry the work, we pause it safely. Shen owes us no further service. I accept those terms.
story.sq03.s3.record: Returned charter: Lan accepts spillway and lamp checks; Qiao accepts gauge care and one-shift relief coordination; He accepts the allocation board; Su accepts weekly cross-checks with He. All accept the selected review rota for one season, renewed only by express consent. No automatic successor. Apprentice start-up limit: three days. Released guardian: no duty. Four signed copies match. Safe-pause drill: handle neutral, work release closed, reservoir relief left open; restart only after readings settle.
story.sq03.s3.confirm: Verify the signatures and accept the limited charter.
story.sq03.s3.retry: A consent or check is still missing. Rest at the sanctuary for the reply, and read each duty card. For the drill: handle neutral, work release closed, reservoir relief open; verify the settled indicator. You cannot accept for another person.
story.sq03.s3.done: Handover accepted. The shared cycle now has named duties, limits, relief, and a safe way to stop.
story.sq03.epilogue.open: The first charter stays on the wall while the apprentice serves as temporary regulator. The names prevent their bridge from becoming a new thirteen-year silence; the group continues building the full maintenance network.
story.sq03.epilogue.seal: The signatories adapt their accepted duties to the alternative channel. The guardian clause remains in the retired archive: release is not a transfer of his obligation to someone else.
story.sq03.epilogue.shared: At the first seasonal review, Qiao declines another relief term. The others recruit a willing replacement before renewing the rota. The pause rule is discussed openly, even with the river running well.
story.sq03.pending_status: Accepted plan: {effective}. Proposal awaiting confirmation: {pending}. The final decision uses the accepted plan, not an unanswered proposal.
